# Samuel Baird

> Samuel Baird builds public data tools and makes videos about religion, history and ideas. He created Latter-day Stats (statistics, research and creator data on the Latter-day Saint community), contributed to Pulpit (every General Conference discourse since 1830), and keeps a map of 35 sacred sites he has visited. Everything is free, independent and ad-free. Original data is CC BY 4.0: attribute and link to https://samuelbaird.com.

Figures for external sites are dated November 2026.

## Projects
All projects: [https://samuelbaird.com/projects](https://samuelbaird.com/projects). Every project except the Deseret Wiki lives at https://samuelbaird.com/<project>.

- [Latter-day Stats](https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/): Statistics, research and creator data on the Latter-day Saint community. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/latter-day-stats)
  - Tracks 328 LDS YouTube channels with 16.6M combined subscribers
  - Curates 73 academic studies and 58 survey graphics
  - Data Explorer for Pew, CCES and other public survey data
  - MCP endpoint: https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/mcp
  - [Data Explorer](https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/data-explorer)
  - [Studies](https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/studies)
  - [Channels](https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/channels)
  - [Use with AI](https://samuelbaird.com/latter-day-stats/connect)
- [Deseret Wiki](https://deseret.wiki/): A library, encyclopaedia and primer of the Deseret Alphabet. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/deseret-wiki)
  - Scans of the Deseret readers, the 1869 Book of Mormon and the Deseret News
  - Articles on the alphabet's people, letters, works and variants
  - Every known Deseret font with specimens and licenses
  - Read any page in the Deseret alphabet with one toggle
  - [The Alphabet](https://deseret.wiki/wiki/deseret-alphabet/)
  - [Library](https://deseret.wiki/library/)
  - [Fonts](https://deseret.wiki/fonts/)
  - [Quotes](https://deseret.wiki/quotes/)
- [Urim](https://samuelbaird.com/urim/): The Mormon Translation Atlas: how the Church translates its own vocabulary. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/urim)
  - 367 concepts with evidence
  - 125,650 aligned General Conference paragraphs
  - 41,994 aligned scripture verses
  - English, Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish
  - MCP endpoint: https://samuelbaird.com/urim/mcp
  - [Atlas](https://samuelbaird.com/urim/)
  - [Variants](https://samuelbaird.com/urim/variants)
  - [Proclamations](https://samuelbaird.com/urim/proclamations)
  - [Use with AI](https://samuelbaird.com/urim/connect)
- [Pulpit](https://pulpit.restorationcommons.org/): Every General Conference discourse since 1830, graded for fidelity. Samuel Baird is a contributor. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/pulpit)
  - 12,201 discourses since 1830
  - 4,292 graded verbatim
  - Each talk traced to its best surviving witness
- [Deseret MCP](https://mcp.deseret.wiki/): Deseret Alphabet transliteration and Deseret Wiki search for AI assistants. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/deseret-mcp)
  - MCP endpoint: https://mcp.deseret.wiki/mcp
  - English to Deseret and back, phonetically
  - Searches every Deseret Wiki article
  - [Connect](https://mcp.deseret.wiki/connect)
  - [About](https://mcp.deseret.wiki/about)
- [Peepstone](https://samuelbaird.com/peepstone/): Search and read the Joseph Smith Papers from any AI assistant. [About](https://samuelbaird.com/projects/peepstone)
  - MCP endpoint: https://samuelbaird.com/peepstone/mcp
  - Full-site search with people, place and subject facets
  - Reads any document page with footnotes and citation
  - People, places, glossary, events and the Calendar of Documents
  - Not affiliated with the Joseph Smith Papers Project
- [Sacred Sites Visited](https://samuelbaird.com/sacred-sites): A map of every church, temple and house of worship visited since 2025.
- [My Reading](https://samuelbaird.com/books): Every book and article read, with the date finished.
- [Collection](https://samuelbaird.com/collection): Historic Latter-day Saint books, periodicals and artifacts.
  - Sacred sites: [directory of every site](https://samuelbaird.com/sacred-sites/sites), [photos](https://samuelbaird.com/sacred-sites/photos) and [traditions](https://samuelbaird.com/sacred-sites/traditions).
- [Wishlist](https://samuelbaird.com/wishlist): books and equipment he would like for the YouTube channel, most wanted first.

## Answers and data
- [FAQ](https://samuelbaird.com/faq): direct answers with dated figures.
- [Open data](https://samuelbaird.com/data): CSV and JSON downloads, field descriptions, license and citation.
  - [sacred-sites.csv](https://samuelbaird.com/data/sacred-sites.csv), [sacred-sites.json](https://samuelbaird.com/data/sacred-sites.json)
  - [reading-list.csv](https://samuelbaird.com/data/reading-list.csv), [reading-list.json](https://samuelbaird.com/data/reading-list.json)
- [About](https://samuelbaird.com/about): who he is, how the projects connect, how to cite.
